二维码绑定唯一充电桩编号。系统会先检查电站运营状态和设备状态，只有空闲设备才能创: Each QR code identifies one charger. The system checks station and charger status before starting. Only available chargers can accept a new order.
选一个附近电站，为爱车补充能量。: Choose a nearby station to recharge your car.
电费 + 服务费 = 用户实际单价: Energy fee + service fee = customer rate
时段不能重叠。若需要跨午夜，请拆成 18:00-24:00 和 00:00-08: Time periods cannot overlap. Split periods that cross midnight, for example 18:00–24:00 and 00:00–08:00.
模拟充值，仅用于课程演示，不产生真实付款。: Demo top-up only. No real payment will be made.
新增电站时会自动生成早/日间/晚三个分时价格；之后请到“价格管理”单独调整。: Three time-of-use rates are created automatically for a new station. Adjust them on the Pricing page.
以现场停车规定为准: Refer to parking rules at the station
解决时必须填写，例如：更换通信模块后恢复正常: Required when resolved, e.g. communication module replaced
用手机相机/微信扫码后进入对应充电桩页面。: Scan with your phone camera or WeChat to open this charger.
路线将在浏览器地图页面规划，需要联网。: Directions open in an external map page. An internet connection is required.
预约成功，电桩为你保留 15 分钟: Reserved. Your charger is held for 15 minutes.
您有未完成的充电订单，请先处理: Please complete your unfinished charging order first
确认后停止模拟充电，按最终电量扣款并释放充电桩。: This stops simulated charging, deducts the final cost and releases the charger.
确认取消此预约并释放充电桩？: Cancel this reservation and release the charger?
仅允许删除没有关联电桩的电站。确定继续？: Only stations with no chargers can be deleted. Continue?
删除此设备？有历史订单的设备无法删除。: Delete this charger? Chargers with order history cannot be deleted.
确定删除这个分时时段？每个电站至少保留一条规则。: Delete this time period? Each station must keep at least one pricing rule.
此浏览器不支持定位，请使用区域选择: Geolocation is unavailable. Please select a district.
定位未成功，请允许定位权限或选择预置区域: Location unavailable. Allow location access or select a district.
管理员可以在电桩管理查看每个设备二维码。手机扫描后登录用户账号，系统会自动识别该: Administrators can view a QR code for each charger. Scan it and sign in to identify the charger automatically.
管理员在价格管理维护电费与服务费；开始充电时锁定当前时段价格。: Administrators manage energy and service fees on the Pricing page. Rates are locked when charging starts.
登记故障后设备变为故障，进入处理中时变为维修中，解决后恢复空闲。: A reported fault marks the charger as faulty. In-progress faults mark it under repair. Resolving the fault restores availability.
请确认 Python 服务已启动，然后刷新页面。: Check that the Python service is running, then refresh this page.

跟随设备的浅色或深色设置；你也可以固定选择喜欢的主题。: Follow your device appearance, or choose a fixed theme.
界面语言和外观会自动保存，重新登录后继续使用。: Language and appearance are saved automatically for your next visit.
登录前保存在此浏览器；登录后同步到当前账号。: Saved in this browser before sign-in; synced to your account after sign-in.

密码至少 8 位: Password must contain at least 8 characters
开始日期不能晚于结束日期: The start date cannot be after the end date
您有欠费订单，请先充值并补缴欠费: You have an outstanding balance. Top up and pay it first.

电费和服务费不能同时为 0: Energy and service fees cannot both be zero

该时段与已有价格规则重叠，请先调整时间: This period overlaps an existing pricing rule. Adjust the times.

账号已冻结，请联系管理员: Your account is frozen. Contact the administrator.
